maya (People Ops): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands on remote/hybrid + office ops. I'll answer rapid-fire and pin resources.

li (Eng): If I plan a 5-day SF week, what's covered for travel & lodging?

maya (People Ops): Domestic flights up to $500; hotels default $250/night, $325/night in SF/NY/LON. Receipts required. Use ops:satellite:travel unless charging a project.

sam (Eng-Infra): How do we reserve recurring desks for a team visit?

carlos (People Ops): File a Team Space Request (pinned). For ad-hoc days use hot-desk booking at internal.redwood.com/office-booking. Book flex-week slots by the Wednesday prior.

li (Eng): Family joining an offsite — covered?

rebecca (People Ops): Family travel not covered by default. Childcare reimbursement up to $150/day for company overnight offsites with manager sign-off; submit receipts. Spouse travel considered only for caregiver/medical reasons via exception form.

ana? (typo)

ana (Finance): Expense reminder: submit via Expensify within 14 days. For multi-currency travel include card FX screenshots and the event tag.

sam (Eng-Infra): Moving demo hardware between sites 100: rules?

carlos (People Ops): Anything >$2k requires IT + legal sign-off and a signed transport form. Small peripherals ok. Shipments should be logged in the hardware transfer tracker.

li (Eng): Visa letters / timelines for international offsites?

maya (People Ops): Start 68 weeks out. Attach passport scan + itinerary in the travel request. We can cover expedited fees with approval.

li (Eng): Home office stipend if I'm alternating offices?

rebecca (People Ops): Stipend unchanged: $600/year or one-time ergonomic setup up to $1,200 with manager approval. For a permanent satellite desk, submit a one-time desk-setup request.

offsite-bot: Poll created "Offsite month preference" Apr / May / Sep. Results in 24h.

maya (People Ops): Thanks all  I'll post a 1-page FAQ and update the offsite kit with these clarifications. DM @carlos or @maya for exceptions. :wave:
